name: Power Automate
description: Microsoft Power Automate is a low-code automation platform that combines cloud-based workflow automation (DPA) with robotic process automation (RPA) to connect apps, desktops, and legacy systems.
best_for: Organizations already invested in Microsoft 365 and Azure that need to automate both cloud app workflows and legacy desktop processes with a single low-code platform.
features: Cloud flows for connecting apps and services (DPA)
Desktop flows for attended and unattended RPA on legacy systems
Copilot for natural-language flow creation and editing
AI Builder for document and image processing
1,400+ prebuilt, certified connectors including native Microsoft 365 integration
Process mining and task mining to discover automation opportunities
Managed Environments with governance and data-loss-prevention controls
Mobile browser access to the Power Automate portal; approvals remain available through Microsoft Teams and Outlook after the standalone mobile app deprecation

alternatives.name: Zapier
alternatives.description: A no-code automation platform that connects thousands of web apps through simple trigger-and-action workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want fast, no-code automations between cloud apps

alternatives.name: UiPath
alternatives.description: An enterprise automation platform combining robotic process automation, AI agents, and process orchestration.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises scaling RPA and agentic automation across complex systems

alternatives.name: Workato
alternatives.description: An enterprise integration and automation platform connecting SaaS and on-premises systems with AI agent orchestration.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises needing deep integrations across many business functions

alternatives.name: Zoho Flow
alternatives.description: An AI-powered integration platform that connects cloud and on-premises apps and automates workflows across departments.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses already using Zoho's app ecosystem who want no-code workflow automation across 1,000+ apps

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: $15/user/month, paid yearly; cloud flows, attended desktop flows, and limited process mining.

tiers.name: Process
tiers.notes: $150/bot/month, paid yearly; unattended automation and business-critical processes.

tiers.name: Hosted Process
tiers.notes: $215/bot/month, paid yearly; includes a Microsoft-hosted virtual machine.

cons: There is a 30-day trial but no permanent standalone free Power Automate plan on the current pricing page.
Licensing differs by user, bot, hosted bot, and add-on; unattended scenarios can also require additional licenses for the software being automated, and flows remain subject to service/action limits.
